headline: Findlay reverse their home defeat by Tiffin
dek: Findlay's win over Tiffin on Thursday was their twelfth of the season, more than any other programme has managed, and it came on the ground where Tiffin had beaten them in October. They host Kentucky Wesleyan on Saturday in the only match left on the calendar.
displaced_by: Thursday's matches were played; the standing dek still described them as to come.
